metaTitle: How Tents Handle Wind by Design
description: Domes, tunnels and cabin tents respond to wind differently. Learn which shape holds up, what poles and guy points matter, and how to pitch.
directAnswer: Domes and tunnels with low, curved shapes handle wind best when fully staked, while tall cabin tents catch the most wind. Orient the narrow end into the wind, use every guyline and keep the tent taut and low.
